steps.content: (Scene change)
Like an enormous soap bubble bursting, everything returns to square one.
The space has been reset. Every citizen who once stepped inside has their memories erased, just as they were at the start.
Even the lingering summer heat seems to have been carried away by the sea breeze.
You return to the fully restored Elysiland, now completely deserted.
For a fleeting moment, you think you see Dreya as she once was.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Young Dreya
steps.content: Can I ask you something, sir?
steps.female_content: Can I ask you something, miss?

steps.content: The little girl keeps tugging at your arm.

steps.speaker: Young Dreya
steps.content: What if... what if I forget everything someday?!

steps.speaker: Young Dreya
steps.content: Oh, but I don't want to forget everything... then I'll just remember the stars and you!

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: When that time comes, I'll help you remember.

steps.speaker: Young Dreya
steps.content: Really? But what if I just can't?

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Then I'll just keep trying. That's what friends are for.

steps.speaker: Young Dreya
steps.content: Hehe! You're the best!
The smell of something burning floods your nostrils, pulling you back to reality.
You follow the trail of smoke...
And there, on the beach at night, several familiar figures are bustling about.
Jane is helping at the grill, Bai Yi is hanging up a sign, and Lamia is perched on a rock, reading a book.
The troublemaking Sinners have returned to this beach, but you realize someone's missing.
You search everywhere, but there's no sign of her.
As you sit on a rock, staring blankly at the shore...
A skewer with half a burnt eel appears before you.

steps.speaker: Dreya
steps.content: Grilled eel... would you like to try some?
